name: British Columbia Penitentiary
scope: The standing Gothic Revival Gatehouse with ceremonial stair, original Second Empire Gaol Block, and the surviving Wharf Warehouse at Sapperton Landing.

review.notes: Checked Qualla imagery first. The cleared story illustration depicts the unrelated Peace Arch. The archival 1877 construction photograph was not used because the native rights record does not establish its U.S. public-domain basis. Geometry follows written heritage and park records and native mapped outlines.
